name: Minimum
description: Live toggle optimization mod for Geometry Dash. Stronger lag reduction on dense levels, recording and Discord share. Change settings anytime without restart. Sequel to Algebra Dash.

mod-enabled.name: Enable Minimum
mod-enabled.description: Master on off switch. Toggle anytime in a level with no restart. Use this to compare FPS with and without the mod.

performance-mode.name: Performance Mode
performance-mode.description: Strongest opts for dense levels, OBS and Discord share. Applies instantly.

skip-static-batch.name: Skip Empty Batches
skip-static-batch.description: Skip draw for sprite batches with zero quads. Live toggle.

cull-particles.name: Cull Offscreen Particles
cull-particles.description: Stop updating and fully pause particle systems far off screen. Live toggle.

limit-particles.name: Limit Particle Count
limit-particles.description: Hard cap particles per system. Cuts lag spikes from particle spam. Live toggle.

particle-cap.name: Particle Cap
particle-cap.description: Max particles per system. Lower = more FPS. Try 40 to 60 on Amethyst style levels.

reduce-emission.name: Reduce Particle Emission
reduce-emission.description: Cuts how fast particles spawn. Big help on lag spikes. Live toggle.

emission-scale.name: Emission Scale
emission-scale.description: Multiplier for particle spawn rate when Reduce Particle Emission is on. 0.25 means 25 percent of normal.

skip-particle-draw.name: Skip Offscreen Particle Draw
skip-particle-draw.description: Do not draw particles that are off screen. Saves GPU under capture. Live toggle.

fast-alt-tab.name: Fast Alt Tab
fast-alt-tab.description: Skip save when the game loses focus.

force-rgba8888.name: Force RGBA8888
force-rgba8888.description: Sharper textures. Windows only. Needs texture reload or level reenter.

anti-aliasing.name: Anti Aliasing
anti-aliasing.description: MSAA 0 off to 4 x16. Costs FPS while recording. Keep at 0 for best performance.
